description: The DFS cluster metadata collections of the kernel's MongoDB backend (expDFSFileHandlerMongoDBBackend). One document per clustered file; _id is name_hash (md5 of name), so a path has one document and the unique _id index is the lock of a cache generation. size and mtime are 64 bit integers; a deleted file keeps its document with mtime -ABS(mtime) and expired 1 until it is purged. exp:cluster:enable creates them; by hand: expDFSFileHandlerMongoDBBackend::createSchema().
